entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-30
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • question for the roslyn development team #81491
  • IDE0048 triggers for `is null` but not for `is not null` in null-coalescing expressions #81488

Closed

  • Compiler incorrectly allows implicit conversion from long to int #81490
  • Avoid `virtual` implementations for `AddSynthesizedAttributes` #78655
  • VS2026 11116.177 ignores fade out unused members settings #81012
    18.3

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix IDE0048 to trigger consistently for `is null` and `is not null` in coalesce expressions #81489
    VSCode

Merged

  • Avoid `virtual` implementations for `AddSynthesizedAttributes` #81289
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Do not offer to add a `using namespace` on an alias qualified name. #81487
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next

Updated

  • Simplifying internal structure and logic for the SyntaxNodeCache #80825
    Area-Compilers
  • Assert shape of the bound tree #81486
    Area-Compilers
  • Suppress CS0119 when CS0075 is reported for negative cast #81283
    Area-Compilers
  • Add replacement property names to VB syntax obsolete attributes #81272
    Area-Compilers
  • Improve error message for misplaced variable designator in property patterns #81287
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix CS1003 error message when expression follows identifier without '=' #81285
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Fix incorrect code generation on async iterators #81468
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Use single argument overload for `[start..]` of `string` or `Span` #81485
    Area-Compilers, Community
